d:
Mumbai ke Kokum Ghat Bridge par raat hote hi sunai deta hai ek purani train ka horn, aur dikhai deti hai safed saari mein ek rahasyamayi aurat. Kaha jaata hai ki 1974 ke ek train haadse ke baad se Sunita naam ki ek mahila ki laash kabhi nahi mili. Jab railway guard Rajesh ki night shift mein uska saamna is rooh se hota hai, toh woh ek aise khaufnaak raaz ka hissa ban jaata hai jisse bachkar nikalna aasaan nahi.
Kya Sunita aaj bhi us train ka intezaar kar rahi hai jo kabhi apni manzil tak nahi pahunchi?
Dekhiye Sannata
